selection_reason: Gradient Boosting Regressor selected. The best non-tree candidate (Multi-Layer Perceptron Regressor) was ahead by only -0.0004 R-squared, inside the 0.02 margin, so the exact-SHAP-explainable model is preferred -- explainability is a stated requirement and the accuracy difference does not pay for losing it.
label_provenance: Metrics are measured against the synthetic label 'synthetic_welfare_risk_score', produced by latent_welfare_risk() in scripts/generate_synthetic_data.py. They quantify how closely the model reproduces that generator formula, not predictive validity against real welfare outcomes, which would require field labels this build does not have. See docs/model_comparison_report.md section 5.

conformal.note: Coverage is with respect to the label the model was trained on. On the synthetic corpus that label is the generator's formula plus injected noise; the interval quantifies model error against that label and is not validation against real welfare outcomes.
